lessons: The review return path worked as designed: a changes-required verdict returned the cycle to Plan with a recorded assessment, loop 2 revised the plan and passed, and the pass limit would have paused a third loop for owner approval.

The crux:developer role requires a base SHA, a result-file path and a worktree commit in its dispatch; the cycle skill's assignment guidance does not name these, so the first loop-1 dispatch returned NEEDS_CONTEXT.

Claude Code removes an unchanged agent worktree when the agent returns; resuming that agent then finds no worktree. The developer recovered by creating a named worktree from the base SHA. Dispatches should carry the base SHA from the start.
The mods gate in dev phase checks only the capability manifest; the mods test suite needs its own declared check.
Rendering the real pane from the cycle records with a small deno renderer exposed the narrow-width defect before review confirmed it.
reflection.outcome: Delivered in two loops. The cycle pane now draws a bold title; the type, a loop icon with 'loop N' and a status glyph and word; a phase track; a phase-labelled task strip with a progress bar; and task rows grouped by phase with state glyphs. Colour and bold mark progress, and a glyph or word carries every distinction. Loop 1 failed review on two blockers: the narrow track lost the current phase, and the arrow separator was East Asian Ambiguous. Loop 2 fixed both, took five advisories, and was approved. The band and the /crux-dashboard answer text are unchanged. mods-tests 604 pass, the mods manifest is unchanged, and the OpenCode dev gate passes with 280 tests.
remaining: The official release owes a live OpenCode 2 check from the beta install, because draw.ts is a core file crux-opencode imports.
Optional review notes: an abandoned-cycle case in the narrow-width test, the identical ternary in cycle-dashboard.test.ts, and the low-contrast subtle key for the review phase word.
Name the developer dispatch contract (base SHA, result file, worktree commit) in the cycle skill's delegation guidance.
Merge branch cyc-0002-cycle-pane or commit the applied working-tree change, then remove the agent worktrees.

review_policy.rationale: Repository default. Presentation-only change to a shared drawing module; it renders reader-supplied free text, so the review confirms text still passes drawn() and terminal-control stripping. It ships to two harnesses.
